verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an automation platform, but no evidence item documents batch or bulk execution across many items, such as looping or bulk record updates. The cited material covers only single actions run via MCP, the SDK or stored actions. The community anecdote about mass duplicate invites describes a misconfigured Zap, not a documented bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
